title: Iowa Experience Crew Led Engineering Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step behind the scenes of a historic U.S. Navy battleship and experience the power that kept it moving. The Engineering Tour takes you deep below deck into areas most visitors never see, where massive machinery, original equipment, and narrow passageways tell the story of life at sea.

Led by an accredited guide, you’ll explore the ship’s engineering spaces while hearing real stories of the sailors who operated these complex systems under pressure. From the roar of the engine rooms to the intricate mechanics that powered the vessel, this immersive experience brings history to life in a way you won’t forget.

If you’re looking for a unique, hands-on perspective of naval history, this is a must-do experience aboard Battleship IOWA. Book now and discover what truly powered this legendary ship.
